androidtv.notes: Lyrics: on Now Playing, pick Lyrics: On to see the words of the song, line by line as it plays.

phone.notes: Lyrics on Now Playing (tap the card for all the words), and download songs or whole albums to play offline: Download in a song's menu or on an album. They show in Music > Downloaded.

windows.notes: Trailers: a Trailer button on movie and show pages plays the title's trailer.
